# docs/templates

Templates for documents, ADRs, episodes and agent prompts: `DOC.md` (controlled document, checked by
`just doc-check`) and `ADR.md` (checked by `just adr-check`), both by WO-003; `EPISODE.md` (master plan 6.1
record), `prompt-builder.md` and `prompt-reviewer.md` (paste-ready, SL-PLAN-003), by WO-012.
